plates.reference: Own code graphic: on period paper, the 5-date timeline completes: Jul 1907 (Leo Baekeland in Yonkers, New York, invents Bakelite, the first fully synthetic plastic) · 1920–1926 (Hermann Staudinger proves polymers are giant covalent macromolecule chains of thousands of atoms) · 6 Apr 1938 (Roy Plunkett and Jack Rebok saw open an 'empty' frozen TFE gas cylinder at DuPont to discover PTFE / Teflon) · 1954 (Marc Grégoire coats aluminium pans with Teflon to create Tefal non-stick cookware) · 1965 (Stephanie Kwolek spins a cloudy liquid-crystalline aramid solution into bulletproof Kevlar, 5× stronger than steel by weight) alongside the 400 million tonnes/year global plastic production curve.
